name: ResetGsPaths
evidence: original assembly: resets the paths to the GS, driving VU0 and VIF1 with macro instructions (InitDmaChannels calls it)

name: WaitGsPaths
evidence: original assembly: waits until the paths to the GS are idle (FlipDisplayFrame calls it)

name: ResetGs
evidence: in mode 0 resets the GS, records the interlacing, video mode, field mode and GS version in g_gsParams, removes its handler and sets the video mode; mode 1 only resets, mode 5 only records and sets (InitDisplay calls it)

name: WriteDisplayRegisters
evidence: writes a display environment's words to the GS's privileged registers (0x12000000 on), by the layout of the GS version in g_gsParams

name: SendDrawEnvironment
evidence: waits for DMA channel 2 to finish and sends a drawing environment's packet through it

name: SetUpDoubleBuffer
evidence: defines the two display and drawing environments of a double buffer for a pixel format, width and height, with an optional clear (InitDisplay calls it)

name: SwapDoubleBuffer
evidence: writes the display registers of one half of a double buffer and sends the other half's drawing environment (FlipDisplayFrame calls it)

name: SwapGsInterruptMask
evidence: reads the GS interrupt mask, writes a new one and returns the old

name: SetFieldDrawOffset
evidence: sets a drawing environment's offset from its centre, half a line lower on the odd field (FlipDisplayFrame calls it)

name: DefineDisplayEnvironment
evidence: fills a display environment for a pixel format and size, printing its message for an unsupported display mode (SetUpDoubleBuffer calls it)

name: CountFrameBufferPages
evidence: returns the GS pages a frame buffer of a pixel format and size takes, doubled when g_gsParams says interlaced frame mode

name: DefineDrawEnvironment
evidence: original assembly: fills a drawing environment for a pixel format, size and offset (SetUpDoubleBuffer calls it)

name: DefineClearPacket
evidence: original assembly: fills the packet that clears a rectangle (SetUpDoubleBuffer calls it when asked to clear)
